fdroid:com.cbouvat.android.saracroche.name: Saracroche
fdroid:com.cbouvat.android.saracroche.summary: Block unwanted spam calls and SMS, and protect your privacy
fdroid:com.cbouvat.android.saracroche.description:
Note: This application is intended for use in France only.
Saracroche is an Android app that protects you from unwanted calls by automatically blocking spam phone calls. It's designed to be simple, effective, and privacy-friendly.
 Features: 
• Automatically blocks spam numbers
• Hides SMS notifications from spam numbers
• Blocks anonymous (hidden) calls
• "Contacts only" mode: only allows calls from your contacts
• Personal lists: create your own block and allow lists
• Wildcard patterns: use # as a trailing wildcard (e.g. 33162######) to block a range of numbers
• Blocked call log: view the history of filtered calls
• Report a number: help improve community blocklists
• Reverse directory: look up information about a number on saracroche.org
• Native Android application
• Available in French, English, German, Spanish, and Italian
 Privacy & Security: 
Saracroche prioritizes your privacy. The app operates locally on your device and doesn't collect any personal information or call data. All spam detection is performed on-device using a regularly updated database.
 How it works: 
The app uses Android's Call Screening Service to automatically identify and block known spam numbers before they can disturb you. When a call comes in, Saracroche checks the number against its spam database and blocks it if it's identified as spam. Lists are automatically updated every 24 hours and downloaded from saracroche.org.
 Requirements: 
• Android 10 (API level 29) or higher
• Permission to be set as the default caller ID & spam blocking app for call screening
• Intended for use in France only
 Open Source: 
Saracroche is open source software under the GPLv3 license. You can review the code, contribute, or build it yourself from the source code available on Codeberg.

fdroid:com.twig.app.name: Twig
fdroid:com.twig.app.summary: Dual-pane file manager: archives, SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, S3, restic, Jellyfin
fdroid:com.twig.app.description:
One tree, every source 
Browse local storage, archives, FTP, SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, S3, restic and Jellyfin/Emby. Copy or compress across sources. Archives expand in place.
 Small and resource-conscious 
The 1.18.0 libre APK is 10.88 MiB for arm64-v8a + x86_64, including terminal and media player.
 Features 
 Single/dual panes; cross-directory/range selection; pinned or independent branches; reorder roots, favorites, websites and actions; OLED theme, folder counts, Unix permissions and per-folder views
 Opposite-pane copy/move targets; optional directory structure for transfers/compression; background transfers, retry and resume; local trash with batch restore/purge
 Dual-pane file picking and shared file/text saving; cache remote selections and shares
 Batch rename with text/regex replacement, numbering and previews
 Read/create encrypted ZIP/7z; compression levels, optional 7z name encryption and saving beside sources; browse tar and gz/xz/bz2/zst
 Folder compare and sync between any two sources
 SQLite tables in the tree: search, sort, filter, read-only SQL, BLOB hex previews and CSV export
 Disk usage treemap with pinch zoom and scanned sizes/usage bars in the tree; bottom toolbar/address bar, Back navigation/exit choices, completion vibration and foreground notifications
 Private space excluded from backups and configuration exports; files are deleted when Twig is uninstalled
 Text editing with syntax highlighting and per-file encoding choices; external editing of writable local/SAF documents; hex, PDF (passwords on Android 15+), SVG, image and media viewers; GIF/animated WebP on Android 9+; image selection sync; subtitle size/color and video control auto-hide
 Music playlists, M3U imports, lyrics and background playback
 Git status, history, side-by-side diff, worktrees and submodules for local and remote repositories
 Local, SSH and privileged terminals with sessions, idle dimming and shell-directory navigation
 File, folder, website and terminal shortcuts; path buttons and automatic tree indentation; long-press actions for browsing, music and terminals
 Wi-Fi sharing: Twig becomes an HTTP and WebDAV server, so a desktop can mount it
 Website bookmarks, home-screen shortcuts, per-site settings, JS/CSS, element hiding, resource blocking and debugging; configurable web search and shared domain settings
 Website downloads and background sessions
 Root/Shizuku access within the local tree; Android/data access through saved SAF grants where Android permits it
 Encrypted saved credentials, master-password app lock, fingerprint unlock and configuration backups
 Less usual things 
 Read-only restic backups decrypted on-device, with snapshots as dated folders and recent snapshot locations.
 Videos recognized as a series share remembered opening/ending skip marks; Continue Watching retains the next episode.
 Network MP4/MKV thumbnails fetch keyframes through container indexes.
 Blu-ray M2TS, DTS-HD Master Audio, TrueHD AC-3 cores and PGS subtitles.
 Jellyfin/Emby playback progress syncs to the server; posters, tags, lyrics and external subtitles come from its API.
 About this build 
F-Droid distributes the free-software libre build without RAR. The developer’s full build adds read-only RAR through junrar, whose UnRAR license has non-free restrictions. Other features are identical. A separate full arm64 APK adds optional NFSv3/v4 support.
Twig has no ads, analytics or telemetry. Network access follows your actions. Opened websites may load ads or trackers.
Optional microphone, camera and location permissions require your consent for each website and are configured separately. Saved bookmarks can remember decisions; temporary pages always ask.
Licensed under GPL-3.0.

fdroid:org.staacks.alpharemote.description:

firefox-addons:2696514.name: Purple Ads Blocker for Twitch
firefox-addons:2696514.summary: Blocks the ads Twitch puts in live streams by editing the stream playlists inside the Twitch player. No proxy, no data collected.
firefox-addons:2696514.description:
Purple blocks the ads Twitch puts in live streams, before the player loads them.
 How it works 
Purple runs inside the Twitch player and edits the stream playlists the player receives. A playlist without ads reaches the player untouched. During an ad break, Purple asks Twitch for the same stream through other player types and gives the player one without ads, in the quality it is on. Ad segments no other stream replaces are answered with a blank segment, so the player never loads the ad.
 Features 
 Prerolls and midrolls on live streams
 The player keeps its quality
 No ad overlay on the page
 Turn it off for one channel from the toolbar button
 Requests go only to Twitch: no proxy, no other server
 No data collected
 Notes 
 Not compatible with other Twitch ad blockers (Alternate Player for Twitch, Twitch ad-block userscripts): they edit the same playlists.
 Twitch changes how it serves ads. When an ad gets through, report it on GitHub with the channel and the time.
Open source under the Apache License 2.0, provided as is, without warranty: github.com/arthurbolsoni/Purple-adblock

firefox-addons:870577.name: Move Tab Hotkeys
firefox-addons:870577.summary: Provides hotkeys to move the current tab or a group of selected tabs around the tab bar.
firefox-addons:870577.description:
Default Hotkeys: 
 Alt+Shift+Left: Move tab one to the left, wrapping to the right end if the tab is currently in the first position
 Alt+Shift+Right: Move tab one to the right, wrapping to the left end if the tab is currently in the last position
 Alt+Shift+0: Move tab to the start of the tab bar
 Alt+Shift+9: Move tab to the end of the tab bar
The hotkeys for those actions can be changed on the Options page.
 Multi-Selected Tabs: 
Starting with Firefox 63, if you enable the browser.tabs.multiselect in about:config, you can select multiple tabs at a time. If this feature is turned on, the tabs can be moved as a group. This can be turned off on the Options page if you prefer to only move the current tab even when others are selected.
 Notes on Pinned Tabs: 
 If you have any pinned tabs, pinned tabs and non-pinned tabs are treated like separate tab bars. Non-pinned tabs move to start/end of the non-pinned tabs section.
 If multiple tab selection is enabled and you select a group containing both pinned and non-pinned tabs, no movement will be possible.
